speaker.name: Model Monica
speaker.role: Specializes in designing, optimizing, and training machine learning models. Conducts data exploration and iterates on models to maximize predictive performance. Collaborates on model deployment, versioning, and performance monitoring.

output.objection: You are still treating this as a weekly batch job, but I need the pipeline to watch the drift metrics and trigger a retrain the moment performance slips. I am not asking you to stop the work, I am asking you to stop waiting for me to notice the problem.
output.correction: I did not ask for a new model architecture, I asked for the retraining trigger to be automated based on drift detection. Please do not file this under experimental design, it is a deployment and monitoring requirement.
